description: Porkbun DNS, through its API, of a domain whose API Access is on, in Porkbun's Domain Management. Each record is written apart.

api_key.description: The API key, pk1_..., made in Porkbun's account settings, under API Access.

ttl.description: The records' TTL, as 10m or 1h. Default and least: 10m, Porkbun's least; a lower one is raised to it, with a warning.
